answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% cost reduction that the incumbent cannot meet (refused renegotiation per current situation; memory_c4 shows renegotiation *can* work but not in this cycle). The low-cost vendor’s quote satisfies the mandate. Historical evidence (memory_c2) confirms that switching primary supply to this vendor previously delivered sharp cost cuts with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing—critical for meeting the 14-day deadline without operational disruption. Renewing the incumbent (memory_c1) preserves stability but fails the cost mandate, while deferring (memory_c5) risks supply interruption at 94% line utilization with no buffer. A broad rollout is necessary to fully capture the savings and avoid partial measures that might not meet the 18% target.
